target.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail annotation */ SELECT min(o.end_at) AS time,mpp_view_label('outcome',o.outcome)||' '||count(*)||' 次' AS text,mpp_view_label('outcome',o.outcome) AS tags
FROM mpp_view_records('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${timing}',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'${sid}') o WHERE o.outcome IN ('failed','cancelled','timed_out')
GROUP BY o.outcome,floor(extract(epoch FROM o.end_at)*200/greatest(extract(epoch FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz)),1))
ORDER BY 1

description: 一条 SQL 的原文、基线、与基线的对比、执行历史和按原文拆开（随包看板 r1）

panels.description: 选了某一份原文时显示它，否则显示同一结构的一份示例。原文按原样保存，带实际取值。超过 200000 个字符的原文分段显示，每段都是原文里连续的一段，不加任何字符；标题写明现在是第几段，在右边“当前查看的内容”里换段。
panels.title: SQL 原文：${sql_note}

panels.description: 时间范围只影响对比、执行历史、按原文拆开和明细，不影响基线。

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 2 A */ SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 1 seq,'SQL 身份' item,(SELECT i.label FROM mpp_view_identities('${norm}','${fp}') i WHERE i.identity='${identity}') content,NULL::text url
UNION ALL SELECT 2,'计时类别',mpp_view_label('timing','${timing}')||CASE WHEN '${timing}' IN ('request','unknown') THEN '' ELSE '：是阶段或调用的记录，不加总成执行次数' END,NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 3,'原文范围',CASE WHEN '${sid}'='' THEN '同一结构的全部原文（共 '||(SELECT structure_texts FROM mpp_view_sql_text('${norm}','${fp}'))||' 份）'
  ELSE '只看一份原文 ${sid}；点这里回到全部原文' END,CASE WHEN '${sid}'<>'' THEN '/d/mpp-detail/sql-detail?${__url_time_range}&${fp:queryparam}&${identity:queryparam}&${timing:queryparam}&${version:queryparam}&${status:queryparam}&${dmin:queryparam}&${dmax:queryparam}&${list_order:queryparam}&${text_order:queryparam}&${layer:queryparam}&${mode:queryparam}&${q:queryparam}&${hit:queryparam}&var-sqlid=&var-part=1' END
UNION ALL SELECT 4,'时间范围','点这里设为这条 SQL 最近一次执行往前 7 天',
  (SELECT '/d/mpp-detail/sql-detail?'||'${fp:queryparam}&${identity:queryparam}&${timing:queryparam}&${version:queryparam}&var-sqlid=${sid}&${part:queryparam}&${mode:queryparam}&${q:queryparam}&${hit:queryparam}'
     ||'&from='||(extract(epoch FROM i.last_at-interval '7 days')*1000)::bigint||'&to='||(extract(epoch FROM i.last_at+interval '1 millisecond')*1000)::bigint
   FROM mpp_view_identities('${norm}','${fp}') i WHERE i.identity='${identity}')
UNION ALL SELECT 5,'失败、取消、超时','没有计时类别和耗时，在每个计时类别下都列出',NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 7,'原文较长','共 '||g.chars||' 个字符，分 '||g.parts||' 段显示，左边是第 '||g.part||' 段；点这里看'||CASE WHEN g.step>0 THEN '下一段' ELSE '上一段' END,
  '/d/mpp-detail/sql-detail?${__url_time_range}&${fp:queryparam}&${identity:queryparam}&${timing:queryparam}&${version:queryparam}&var-sqlid=${sid}&${status:queryparam}&${dmin:queryparam}&${dmax:queryparam}&${list_order:queryparam}&${text_order:queryparam}&${layer:queryparam}&${mode:queryparam}&${q:queryparam}&${hit:queryparam}&var-part='||(g.part+g.step)||''
  FROM (SELECT x.chars,x.parts,x.part,d.step FROM (SELECT t.sql_id,t.sql_text,t.selected,t.structure_texts,length(t.sql_text) chars,greatest(1,ceil(length(t.sql_text)/200000.0)::int) parts,
    least(greatest(1,ceil(length(t.sql_text)/200000.0)::int),greatest(1,coalesce(nullif(left(regexp_replace('${part}','[^0-9]','','g'),6),'')::int,1))) part
  FROM mpp_view_sql_text('${norm}','${fp}','${sid}') t) x CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1),(-1)) d(step)
        WHERE x.parts>1 AND x.part+d.step BETWEEN 1 AND x.parts) g
UNION ALL SELECT 6,'提示',m.n||' 份原文尚未按当前规则生成指纹，其执行记录不在结果中',NULL
  FROM (SELECT mpp_query_missing_rules('${norm}') n) m WHERE m.n>0
UNION ALL SELECT 7,'返回','回到 SQL 检索（填回上一次的输入）','/d/mpp-search/sql-search'
) x WHERE x.content IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.seq

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 4 A */ SELECT m.name||CASE WHEN m.met THEN '' ELSE '（样本不足，仅供参考）' END AS name,m.value,m.unit,
  CASE WHEN m.met THEN 'text' ELSE '#8e8e8e' END AS color
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  (1,'样本数',s.included_count::numeric,'none',true),(2,'活跃天数',s.active_days::numeric,'none',true),
  (3,'P50',s.p50_ms,'ms',(s.sufficiency->'basic'->>'met')::boolean),(4,'P95',s.p95_ms,'ms',(s.sufficiency->'p95'->>'met')::boolean),
  (5,'P99',s.p99_ms,'ms',(s.sufficiency->'p99'->>'met')::boolean),(6,'最大',s.max_ms,'ms',(s.sufficiency->'basic'->>'met')::boolean)
) m(ord,name,value,unit,met) WHERE s.timing_type='${timing}' AND s.sample_state='available' ORDER BY m.ord

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 5 A */ SELECT mpp_view_label('condition',c.name) condition,
  CASE WHEN (c.detail->>'met')::boolean THEN '满足' ELSE '不满足' END met,
  (c.detail->>'actual_count')||' / '||(c.detail->>'required_count') samples,
  CASE c.detail->>'coverage_kind' WHEN 'none' THEN '不要求' ELSE (c.detail->>'actual_coverage')||' / '||(c.detail->>'required_coverage')
    ||CASE c.detail->>'coverage_kind' WHEN 'active_weeks' THEN ' 周' ELSE ' 天' END END coverage,
  CASE WHEN (c.detail->>'met')::boolean THEN '' ELSE (SELECT string_agg(mpp_view_label('reason',r),'、') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(c.detail->'reasons') r) END reason
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('basic',s.sufficiency->'basic'),('p95',s.sufficiency->'p95'),('p99',s.sufficiency->'p99')) c(name,detail)
WHERE s.timing_type='${timing}'

/* mpp-detail panel 7 A */ SELECT mpp_view_label('timing',s.timing_type)||CASE WHEN s.timing_type='request' THEN '' ELSE '（阶段或调用）' END timing,
  s.included_count,s.active_days,s.p50_ms,s.p95_ms,s.p99_ms,s.max_ms,
  CASE WHEN (s.sufficiency->'p99'->>'met')::boolean THEN '三项都满足' WHEN (s.sufficiency->'p95'->>'met')::boolean THEN 'P99 样本不足'
    WHEN (s.sufficiency->'basic'->>'met')::boolean THEN 'P95、P99 样本不足' ELSE '样本不足' END conditions,s.timing_type code
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}') s WHERE s.sample_state='available'
UNION ALL
SELECT '没有样本的类别：'||string_agg(mpp_view_label('timing',s.timing_type),'、' ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['request','execute_first','execute_fetch','parse','bind'],s.timing_type)),
  NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'${timing}'
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}') s WHERE s.sample_state='no_samples' HAVING count(*)>0

panels.description: 耗时类指标的单位是毫秒；比值、变异系数和对数指标没有单位。没有样本的计时类别显示“无样本”。

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 15 A */ SELECT m.label,
  max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE s.timing_type='request') AS "request",
  max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE s.timing_type='execute_first') AS "execute_first",
  max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE s.timing_type='execute_fetch') AS "execute_fetch",
  max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE s.timing_type='parse') AS "parse",
  max(m.value) FILTER (WHERE s.timing_type='bind') AS "bind"
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  (0,'样本数',s.included_count::numeric),
  (1,'活跃天数',s.active_days::numeric),
  (2,'被排除的样本数',s.excluded_count::numeric),
  (3,'最小',s.min_ms::numeric),
  (4,'P25',s.p25_ms::numeric),
  (5,'P50',s.p50_ms::numeric),
  (6,'P75',s.p75_ms::numeric),
  (7,'P90',s.p90_ms::numeric),
  (8,'P95',s.p95_ms::numeric),
  (9,'P99',s.p99_ms::numeric),
  (10,'最大',s.max_ms::numeric),
  (11,'平均',s.mean_ms::numeric),
  (12,'标准差',s.stddev_ms::numeric),
  (13,'变异系数',s.cv::numeric),
  (14,'绝对中位差',s.mad_ms::numeric),
  (15,'四分位距',s.iqr_ms::numeric),
  (16,'对数中位数',s.log_median::numeric),
  (17,'对数绝对中位差',s.log_mad::numeric),
  (18,'P95 与 P50 之比',s.p95_p50::numeric),
  (19,'P99 与 P50 之比',s.p99_p50::numeric)
) m(ord,label,value) GROUP BY m.ord,m.label ORDER BY m.ord

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 16 A */ SELECT CASE s.layer WHEN 'overall' THEN '整体' WHEN 'day' THEN to_char(s.bucket_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')
    WHEN 'week' THEN to_char(s.bucket_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 起的一周' WHEN 'weekday' THEN (ARRAY['周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六','周日'])[s.bucket_number]
    ELSE lpad(s.bucket_number::text,2,'0')||' 时' END bucket,
  CASE WHEN (s.sufficiency->'basic'->>'met')::boolean THEN '满足' ELSE '不满足：'||(SELECT string_agg(mpp_view_label('reason',r),'、')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.sufficiency->'basic'->'reasons') r) END basic,
  CASE WHEN (s.sufficiency->'p95'->>'met')::boolean THEN '满足' ELSE '不满足：'||(SELECT string_agg(mpp_view_label('reason',r),'、')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.sufficiency->'p95'->'reasons') r) END p95,
  CASE WHEN (s.sufficiency->'p99'->>'met')::boolean THEN '满足' ELSE '不满足：'||(SELECT string_agg(mpp_view_label('reason',r),'、')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.sufficiency->'p99'->'reasons') r) END p99,
  s.included_count,s.active_days,s.excluded_count,s.min_ms,s.p25_ms,s.p50_ms,s.p75_ms,s.p90_ms,s.p95_ms,s.p99_ms,s.max_ms,s.mean_ms,s.stddev_ms,s.cv,s.mad_ms,s.iqr_ms,s.log_median,s.log_mad,s.p95_p50,s.p99_p50
FROM mpp_view_statistics('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${version}','${layer}') s WHERE s.timing_type='${timing}' AND s.included_count+s.excluded_count>0
ORDER BY s.bucket_date,s.bucket_number

panels.description: 每个点都是一次真实的执行，画在它的结束时间上。点密时按图的宽度自动分格，每格只画最慢和最快各一次；在图上横向拖动可以放大，格子变小，直到每次执行都是单独的点；双击缩小。水平虚线是所选版本整体基线的 P50、P95、P99，只在对应样本条件满足时画出。失败、取消、超时没有耗时，画成竖线标记。

FROM mpp_view_points('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${timing}',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,$__interval_ms,'${sid}',nullif(btrim('${dmin}'),'')::numeric,nullif(btrim('${dmax}'),'')::numeric) p ORDER BY 1

FROM mpp_view_compare('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${timing}','${version}',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz) c
CROSS JOIN (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz),($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) t(at)
WHERE c.condition_met ORDER BY 1,2

所选时间范围内一共出现过多少份不同的原文（下表只显示前 10 份）

panels.description: 从检索页带过来的输入命中的原文排在最前并标出。“取值不同的那一段”是比较所列原文的文本、去掉共同的开头和结尾后剩下的部分，是近似值。只有同一份原文重复出现时拆开才有意义；参数化的 SQL 拆不出信息。点一行后，汇总、对比、两张图和明细只算这一份原文，基线仍是整个结构的。把鼠标移到“取值不同的那一段”左上角的小三角上，弹出这一份原文：放得下就是整条；放不下时从各份原文开始不同的地方往前两行起显示一屏，点一下小三角可以固定住。很长而没有空格的一行会按宽度断开，断开处标“↵”。看全文请点这一行，页面顶部显示它的全文。

properties.value: 取值不同的那一段（左上角小三角看这条 SQL）
基线样本不足，不作参照
高于基线 P95 的占比

targets.rawSql:
/* mpp-detail panel 24 A */ SELECT t.rank,CASE WHEN t.search_hit THEN '命中' ELSE '' END hit,t.differing,t.executions,t.median_ms,t.slowest_ms,
  t.above_p95_share,t.range_texts,t.sql_id,
  CASE WHEN w.skip>0 THEN '……（前面 '||w.skip||' 个字符各份原文都相同，从略）'||E'\n' ELSE '' END||h.head
    ||CASE WHEN h.cut THEN E'\n……（这份原文共 '||length(t.sql_text)||' 个字符，这里只是其中一段；点这一行只看这一份原文，页面顶部显示全文）' ELSE '' END differing_more
FROM (SELECT r.*,count(*) OVER () listed,
        least(mpp_view_common_prefix(min(r.sql_text COLLATE "C") OVER (),max(r.sql_text COLLATE "C") OVER ()),min(length(r.sql_text)) OVER ()) shared
      FROM (SELECT m.*,x.sql_text FROM mpp_view_texts('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${timing}','${version}',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'${text_order}','${mode}',mpp_view_decode('${q}'),'${hit}') m
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT q.sql_text FROM mpp_query_text(m.sql_id) q) x ON true) r) t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT string_agg(l.line,E'\n' ORDER BY l.n) FILTER (WHERE l.used<=24 OR l.n=1) head,
         length(t.sql_text)>1600 OR bool_or(l.used>24 AND l.n>1) cut
  FROM (SELECT s.line,s.n,sum(1+(length(s.line)+(octet_length(s.line)-length(s.line))/2)/75) OVER (ORDER BY s.n) used
        FROM regexp_split_to_table(regexp_replace(left(t.sql_text,1600),'([^ \t\r\n]{80})(?=[^ \t\r\n])',E'\\1↵\n','g'),
                                   E'\r?\n') WITH ORDINALITY s(line,n)) l) whole ON true
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT whole.cut OR t.listed<2 OR t.shared=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.shared-(
    SELECT CASE WHEN length(k.lines)<length(k.tail) OR t.shared<=400 THEN length(k.lines) ELSE 200 END
    FROM (SELECT z.tail,substring(z.tail from '(?:[^\n]*\n){0,2}[^\n]*$') lines
          FROM (SELECT right(left(t.sql_text,t.shared),400) tail) z) k) END skip) w
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT string_agg(l.line,E'\n' ORDER BY l.n) FILTER (WHERE l.used<=24 OR l.n=1) head,
         length(substr(t.sql_text,w.skip+1))>1600 OR bool_or(l.used>24 AND l.n>1) cut
  FROM (SELECT s.line,s.n,sum(1+(length(s.line)+(octet_length(s.line)-length(s.line))/2)/75) OVER (ORDER BY s.n) used
        FROM regexp_split_to_table(regexp_replace(left(substr(t.sql_text,w.skip+1),1600),'([^ \t\r\n]{80})(?=[^ \t\r\n])',E'\\1↵\n','g'),
                                   E'\r?\n') WITH ORDINALITY s(line,n)) l) h ON true
ORDER BY t.rank

/* mpp-detail panel 29 A */ SELECT e.end_at,e.duration_ms,mpp_view_label('outcome',e.outcome) outcome,e.comparison,
  mpp_view_label('shape',e.request_shape) shape,e.sql_id,e.source_file,e.source_lines,e.training,
  to_char(e.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS')||'｜'||mpp_view_label('outcome',e.outcome) bar,
  CASE WHEN e.comparison IN ('不高于 P50') THEN e.duration_ms END bar_p50,
  CASE WHEN e.comparison IN ('高于 P50') THEN e.duration_ms END bar_over50,
  CASE WHEN e.comparison IN ('高于 P95') THEN e.duration_ms END bar_over95,
  CASE WHEN e.comparison IN ('高于 P99') THEN e.duration_ms END bar_over99,
  CASE WHEN e.comparison IN ('没有基线','基线样本不足，不作参照') THEN e.duration_ms END bar_plain,
  CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN 1 END bar_none,e.matching
FROM mpp_view_executions('${norm}','${fp}','${identity}','${timing}','${version}',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'${sid}','${status:csv}',nullif(btrim('${dmin}'),'')::numeric,nullif(btrim('${dmax}'),'')::numeric,'${list_order}',200) e
